s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss in one eye with retinal abnormalities
salient_findings: Visual loss in the left eye
Ischemic macular whitening in the left eye
Abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula in the left eye
key_facts: 2-day history of visual loss in the left eye
No dehydration or other precipitating factors noted
Visual acuity 20/20 OD and 20/800 OS
Right eye examination unremarkable except for peripheral retinal black sunburst lesions
No cherry-red spot, hemorrhage, or peripheral neovascularization in the left eye
Fluorescein angiography showed abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula in the left eye
OCT showed hyperreflective plaques at the level of the INL/OPL in the left eye
OCT showed temporal macular thinning in the right eye

shortlist.label: Sickle cell retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has sickle cell disease and presents with retinal abnormalities

shortlist.label: Central retinal artery occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with acute vision loss in one eye and abnormal retinal capillary bed

shortlist.label: Branch retinal artery occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with acute vision loss in one eye and abnormal retinal capillary bed

shortlist.label: Sickle cell maculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has sickle cell disease and presents with macular abnormalities

shortlist.label: Retinal capillary nonperfusion
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with abnormal retinal capillary bed and ischemic macular whitening

raw.rationale: The patient's history of sickle cell disease and the presence of ischemic macular whitening, abnormal retinal capillary bed, and hyperreflective plaques at the level of the INL/OPL in the left eye are consistent with sickle cell maculopathy.

rejected.label: Central retinal artery occlusion
rejected.why: No cherry-red spot was noted, which is typically present in central retinal artery occlusion

rejected.label: Branch retinal artery occlusion
rejected.why: The fluorescein angiography showed abnormal retinal capillary bed across the macula, not just a branch

rejected.label: Sickle cell retinopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has sickle cell disease, the specific findings are more consistent with maculopathy, a subset of sickle cell retinopathy

rejected.label: Retinal capillary nonperfusion
rejected.why: This is a feature of the patient's condition, but not a specific diagnosis
